This stage has been part of the tournament since the bracket expanded to 64 teams in 1985, and it marks a turning point where teams start to face tougher, top-level opponents. By reaching the Round of 16, teams are guaranteed national exposure, and the games are filled with electric atmospheres and high stakes. Often held in large, regional venues, these games determine which eight teams advance to the Round of 8 and come within arm’s reach of the semifinals.Over the years, the Round of 16 has produced unforgettable moments and epic battles. In 1990, 11-seed Loyola Marymount, led by their emotional run following the tragic death of star player Hank Gathers, reached the Round of 16 in a high-scoring, thrilling season. More recently, in 2013, Florida Gulf Coast University, a 15-seed dubbed “Dunk City,” captivated fans with its high-flying style, upsetting both Georgetown and San Diego State to reach the Round of 16. The Round of 16 has become a place for unexpected heroes and improbable upsets, showcasing the depth of competition and the raw emotion that defines the NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament.What is the 2026 Round of 16 schedule?
